recipes.label: Bind a Plain Notebook
recipes.startdescription: Fold and stitch a quire into a reusable commonplace book. [Requires Stitching & Binding below level 4, paper, and a compatible Soul. Leave ink, tools and memories out.]
recipes.desc: Blank pages, ready for whatever I choose to write.

recipes.label: Bind a Decorated Notebook
recipes.startdescription: Work a more elaborate binding around a quire. [Requires Stitching & Binding level 4 or higher, paper, and a compatible Soul. Leave ink, tools and memories out.]
recipes.desc: A little craftsmanship makes room for a little thought.
